questions.question: The company plans to __________ three new employees next month.

explanation.en: After 'plans to', we use the base form (infinitive) of the verb. 'Hire' is the correct form.
explanation.vi: Sau 'plans to', chúng ta dùng dạng cơ bản (infinitive) của động từ. 'Hire' là dạng đúng.

questions.question: All employees must __________ their identification badges when entering the building.

explanation.en: After 'must', we use the base form of the verb. 'Wear' is correct.
explanation.vi: Sau 'must', chúng ta dùng dạng cơ bản của động từ. 'Wear' là đúng.

questions.question: The report was __________ yesterday afternoon by the manager.

explanation.en: This is passive voice (was + past participle). 'Completed' is the past participle form.
explanation.vi: Đây là câu bị động (was + past participle). 'Completed' là dạng past participle.

questions.question: Ms. Johnson has been with the company __________ ten years.

explanation.en: 'For' is used with duration (ten years). 'Since' is used with a specific time point (e.g., 2015).
explanation.vi: 'For' dùng với khoảng thời gian (ten years). 'Since' dùng với một thời điểm cụ thể.

questions.question: The meeting will take place __________ the conference room on the third floor.

explanation.en: 'In' is used for rooms and enclosed spaces. The meeting is in the conference room.
explanation.vi: 'In' dùng cho phòng và không gian kín. Cuộc họp là trong phòng hội nghị.

questions.question: If the weather is good tomorrow, we __________ the outdoor team building event.

explanation.en: This is a first conditional (if + present, will + base). 'Will hold' is correct.
explanation.vi: Đây là điều kiện loại 1 (if + present, will + base). 'Will hold' là đúng.

vocabulary: team building (n) - xây dựng đội ngũ

questions.question: The new software is much __________ than the old system.

explanation.en: For comparative adjectives, we use 'more + adjective'. 'More efficient' is correct.
explanation.vi: Để so sánh, ta dùng 'more + adjective'. 'More efficient' là đúng.

questions.question: The presentation will be given by Dr. Smith, __________ is a leading expert in the field.

explanation.en: 'Who' is used for people. 'Which' and 'that' are for things. Dr. Smith is a person.
explanation.vi: 'Who' dùng cho người. 'Which' và 'that' dùng cho vật. Dr. Smith là một người.

vocabulary: leading (adj) - hàng đầu, expert (n) - chuyên gia

questions.question: We need to __________ the report before we can submit it to the client.

explanation.en: After 'need to', use the base form. 'Review' is correct.
explanation.vi: Sau 'need to', dùng dạng cơ bản. 'Review' là đúng.

questions.question: Although the prices have increased, sales have __________ grown steadily.

explanation.en: 'Still' means 'continue to happen despite something'. It fits the contrast with 'although'.
explanation.vi: 'Still' có nghĩa 'vẫn tiếp tục'. Nó phù hợp với sự tương phản 'although'.

questions.question: The contract __________ by both parties last Friday.

explanation.en: This is passive voice with past time. 'Was signed' is the correct form (was + past participle).
explanation.vi: Đây là câu bị động ở quá khứ. 'Was signed' là dạng đúng (was + past participle).

questions.question: Employees are encouraged to __________ their ideas during team meetings.

explanation.en: After 'be encouraged to', use the base form (infinitive). 'Share' is correct.
explanation.vi: Sau 'be encouraged to', dùng dạng cơ bản (infinitive). 'Share' là đúng.

questions.question: The budget for this project has been __________ by management.

explanation.en: With 'has been', use past participle. 'Approved' is the correct form.
explanation.vi: Với 'has been', dùng past participle. 'Approved' là dạng đúng.

questions.question: The company provides training to __________ improve employee skills.

explanation.en: 'To help' is an infinitive phrase expressing purpose. 'Help' is correct.
explanation.vi: 'To help' là cụm động từ không định thức biểu thị mục đích. 'Help' là đúng.

questions.question: After __________ the presentation, the manager answered questions from the audience.

explanation.en: After preposition 'after', use gerund (ing form). 'Delivering' is correct.
explanation.vi: Sau giới từ 'after', dùng gerund (dạng -ing). 'Delivering' là đúng.

questions.question: Ms. Chen __________ been promoted to Senior Manager because of her excellent performance.

explanation.en: 'Ms. Chen' is singular, so 'has' is correct. We use 'has' + past participle for present perfect.
explanation.vi: 'Ms. Chen' là số ít, nên 'has' là đúng. Ta dùng 'has' + past participle cho present perfect.

questions.question: The new policy is designed to __________ productivity and reduce costs.

explanation.en: After 'to' in an infinitive phrase, use the base form. 'Increase' is correct.
explanation.vi: Sau 'to' trong cụm động từ không định thức, dùng dạng cơ bản. 'Increase' là đúng.

questions.question: __________ the tight deadline, the team completed the project on time.

explanation.en: 'Despite' and 'In spite of' are used before nouns. The sentence shows contrast, so 'Despite' fits. 'Although' is used before clauses.
explanation.vi: 'Despite' và 'In spite of' dùng trước danh từ. 'Although' dùng trước mệnh đề.

questions.question: The international conference __________ place in Geneva next month.

explanation.en: 'Next month' indicates future time. 'Will take' is the correct future form.
explanation.vi: 'Next month' chỉ thời gian tương lai. 'Will take' là dạng tương lai đúng.

questions.question: Only employees with security clearance are __________ to access the server room.

explanation.en: With 'are', we use past participle. This is passive voice: 'are permitted' means 'are allowed'.
explanation.vi: Với 'are', ta dùng past participle. Câu bị động: 'are permitted' có nghĩa 'được phép'.

vocabulary: security clearance (n) - giấy phép bảo mật
